criteria.description: The scheduled registration-patients gap, bounded contract, owner, authority and exclusions are recorded without promoting CVG-004 or global readiness.
criteria.limitations: Delegated scouts were unavailable after bounded waits and shutdown; this ranking is an integrator decision based on fresh local evidence, not scout consensus or approval.

criteria.description: The existing registration-patients catalog/on-demand API expose exactly eight patient fields, the canonical patients table has account_id and existing RLS/FORCE-RLS coverage, and the worker lacks only the scheduled source/branch.
criteria.limitations: The shared scheduled source, resolver branch and real process proof are not implemented at gate creation. The microchip field remains within the pre-existing report contract and is not expanded.

criteria.description: Focused RED tests are specified to reject the absent source/branch, permissive dates, foreign-account output, malformed patient metadata, non-canonical mapping and overflow before implementation.
criteria.limitations: The new patients source test and worker/process assertions are the planned RED contract location; implementation, disposable PostgreSQL execution, security checks, independent review and reconciliation remain required.

gaps: The shared patients source, worker branch, RED/GREEN tests, real process proof, independent review and reconciliation are not complete at gate creation.
Patients include the existing microchip report field, so PII blast radius is higher than the prior owners/suppliers slices; no additional patient or owner fields are authorized.
Delegated scouts did not return a verdict within the bounded continuation window; no independent scout consensus exists.
conditions: Keep the result limited to the authenticated tenant-scoped scheduled read path over persisted patients and the exact eight-field catalog contract.
Do not add owner joins, owner/patient lifecycle behavior, clinical fields, search filters or any additional PII.
Do not add migrations because the patients table and RLS/FORCE-RLS rails already exist.
Keep CVG-004/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled registration-patients report source through the real worker
authority.decision: Authorize only the repository-local read-only patients source, worker resolution and disposable two-account verification under the existing schedule/audit semantics. The source may expose only code, name, species, breed, sex, microchip, status and createdAt from persisted patients, derive tenant scope from the claimed schedule, apply strict inclusive UTC createdAt dates, deterministic name/id order and a 10,000-row bound, and fail closed on missing/foreign/malformed source output. Exclude owner joins, clinical/lifecycle behavior, additional PII, migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing patients schema/RLS, alerts_json metadata semantics, owner links, patient lifecycle, adding fields/filters/joins, provider delivery, target operations or production behavior.

next_action: Write and run the intentional patients-source, worker and real process RED tests, then implement the smallest bounded tenant-aware source and PostgreSQL proof.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to the patients schema, alerts_json metadata representation or tenant RLS/FORCE-RLS policy
Changes to worker bootstrap, schedule claiming, report execution/export/audit or one-shot failure behavior
Expansion beyond scheduled registration-patients or the existing eight-field contract
